name: @medicalos/extension-medicalos
description: MedicalOS OHIF extension: 'Analyze with MedicalOS' toolbar button and the provenance panel (CONTRACT.md sections 9 and 10, MOS-SAFE-089a).

ohif.comment: Pinned against the viewer medos/deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml ships. The DEPLOYMENT pin (ohif/app:v3.9.2) is the binding one; MOS-REL-027 keeps the viewer replaceable, so this records what it was built against rather than constraining it.
ohif.loadComment: OHIF 3.9's generated pluginImports.js hands any window.config.extensions entry that is not one of its own package names to a native dynamic import(). deploy/compose/ohif-config.js lists '/medicalos/src/index.js' and the pinned image imports this package unbuilt. See README.md section 2.

comment_no_react: React and react-dom were peer dependencies while src/panels/ProvenancePanel.jsx existed. That file is gone and nothing here imports React: a module loaded by a browser import() cannot resolve a bare specifier, and a second React copy would break the first hook the panel called. The panel is a custom element instead (README.md section 2.3).
